notes: Lookalikes get honest about sample size, and the window claim stops hard-coding three years. Fingerprints with 15-199 matching days now carry a thin-sample warning above the figures: at that many events the percentages move several points on a handful of extra days, and nothing in the layout used to say so. Under 15 days it still refuses to print numbers at all. Paired with a worker change that rebuilds the lookalike index over the full stored decade, which nearly triples the evidence behind every fingerprint.
